issues.item: Triggers: Crash Imagery: Cars hit by accident
issues.explanation: 'Cars hit by accident' is poorly matched to the stated trauma type of childhood physical abuse by a caregiver and is not supported by the rest of the profile, which centers on authority/caregiver-related cues, intrusive abuse memory phenomena, helplessness, and avoidance of authority figures. It introduces a distinct accident-trauma theme that is hard to reconcile clinically with the same index trauma.

issues.item: Negative Appraisals: Fear of Rage: I will not be able to control my anger and will do something terrible
issues.explanation: Fear of losing control of anger and doing something terrible is weakly integrated with the rest of the profile. The other items emphasize helplessness, intrusive sensory memory, authority-related triggers, and avoidance, not anger-driven threat or aggression. This appraisal is possible in PTSD, but here it stands out as insufficiently supported by the other selected items and does not align well with the otherwise abuse/helplessness-focused formulation.

issues.item: Negative Appraisals: Fear of Rage: I will not be able to control my anger and will do something terrible

This makes the item clinically out of step with the rest of the formulation.
